issue.title: Replace deprecated Text + concatenation with Text interpolation in bob-mac-capture
issue.description: Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). SwiftUI's Text '+' concatenation operator is deprecated as of macOS 26.0 ('Use string interpolation on Text instead: Text("Hello \(name)")'). grep -rn '+ Text(' finds ~14 call sites across 5 files: CaptureTransferFailureCardView.swift:129, CaptureMoveChoiceView.swift:372-373, CapturePickerView.swift:1115-1128, CapturePanelView.swift:3031-3033 and 3847-3851, Refs/RefsCopyCardView.swift:770-771. Styled segments (.bold(), .foregroundStyle) can move into Text interpolation, which accepts nested Text values. Verify per bob-mac-capture AGENTS.md: scratch-copy typecheck on the Mac, Scripts/macos-ci-check, and watch the exact-SHA macOS CI run to green after pushing.

task_type_fields.impact: Warnings only today: they clutter every local and CI build log and will become hard errors if Apple removes the deprecated operator in a later SDK.
task_type_fields.location: bob-mac-capture Sources/BobMacCapture: CaptureTransferFailureCardView.swift, CaptureMoveChoiceView.swift, CapturePickerView.swift, CapturePanelView.swift, Refs/RefsCopyCardView.swift
task_type_fields.repro: Build bob-mac-capture with the macOS 26 SDK (just install on the Mac or the 'macOS 26 SwiftPM' CI job); the build log prints '+ was deprecated in macOS 26.0' [#DeprecatedDeclaration] warnings at each Text concatenation site.

issue.creation_reason: Found while diagnosing the 4a69ed2 build break: every macOS 26 SwiftPM build of bob-mac-capture emits '+ was deprecated in macOS 26.0' warnings that clutter build and CI logs and will break when Apple removes the operator.
